Reported error: Email verification was not received during account creation; the mobile-number alternative did not work.
Action Taken - Pats: Enabled SMTP verification-email delivery when no Brevo API key is configured, documented the HTTPS email configuration, and prevented a failed resend from invalidating an earlier code. Verified SMTP selection, OTP acceptance and rejection, and failed-resend recovery using isolated fixtures. The verification interface remains email-only; the obsolete mobile-number alternative was already removed. Actual inbox delivery still requires a deployed-service retest.
Resolved - Pats: Local checks passed; deployment retest pending

Reported error: The profile photo upload button was missing; entering a suffix placed name components in the wrong fields.
Action Taken - Pats: Made the faculty photo upload control visible without entering Edit Profile and accessible as a keyboard-operable button. Prevented profile saves from clearing consultation hours and office details. Confirmed that first name, last name, and suffix remain in their correct fields and that the suffix survives saving. Local endpoint and browser checks passed; deployed tester confirmation remains pending.
Resolved - Pats: Local checks passed; deployment retest pending

Reported error: The uploaded student profile photo was not saved correctly.
Action Taken - Pats: Changed student and faculty photo uploads to save validated image content in the database, avoiding loss when an application container is restarted or redeployed. Added an authenticated image endpoint and corrected photo URLs so account parameters survive cache refreshes. Confirmed multipart upload, session reload, image retrieval after a new login, and access restrictions in isolated tests. Previously erased local photos must be uploaded again.
Resolved - Pats: Local checks passed; deployment retest pending

Reported error: The faculty availability status did not update.
Action Taken - Pats: Changed availability updates to apply only after successful server confirmation and to show errors instead of silently displaying an unsaved status. Failed saves restore the displayed selection. Server timestamps and insertion order prevent incorrect device clocks from hiding the latest update. Verified persistence, status mapping, student-directory visibility, and rejected-save feedback using local endpoint and browser checks.
Resolved - Pats: Local checks passed; deployment retest pending

Excluded only the owned request from its slot lookup, guarded against stale responses and duplicate submission, and added a shared booking lock plus transactional request/notification updates. Confirmed successful rescheduling, conflict rejection, persisted student schedule, and notification content in isolated tests.
